artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan nesting MinusLanguage/PlusLanguage/StarLanguage under FormalSystem/Syntax/ as a module-path rename, with the C8 SubformulaClosure prerequisite first and a full doc/invariant sweep.

memory_candidates.content: BimodalLogic directory moves have two non-obvious structural constraints. (1) scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's C8 aggregator check walks a hardcoded `parent` tuple ("FormalSystem", "FormalSystem/Metalogic"), enforced by default via ENFORCE_C8=${ENFORCE_C8:-1}. Adding a parent to that tuple retroactively demands a sibling X.lean aggregator for EVERY Lean-bearing subdirectory of that parent, not just newly moved ones -- so extending C8's scope has a hidden prerequisite of creating any missing aggregator first, or a currently-green C8 turns red. (2) The repo's real convention is that a nested subdirectory KEEPS its component's namespace rather than mirroring its module path (FormalSystem.Syntax.SubformulaClosure.Closure declares `namespace FormalSystem.Syntax`; Metalogic/Conservativity/Plus/Forward.lean declares `namespace FormalSystem.Metalogic.Conservativity`), even though docs/development/MODULE_ORGANIZATION.md section 2 still asserts the opposite. Consequently a nesting move should rewrite ONLY lines beginning `import ` -- a bare token replacement corrupts `open` lines, fully-qualified references, and the C14 `#print axioms` baseline. Gates sensitive to file moves: C4, C5, C8, C12, C13, INV (plus readme-lint Check 3). Gates robust to them: C14 (keys on declaration names) and C20 (suffix-matching path resolver).
